trap state location interpretationBroad weak PL is mainly assigned to trap states. Similar I/III emission maxima but red-shifted II emission suggest a trap governed by well thickness; authors conclude the site is at the CdS/HgS interface rather than the exterior surface. interwell coupling interpretationSystem III’s red shift relative to I is smaller than for adjacent double-layer II, but is interpreted as showing that separated well layers are not independent.
